file_roles.evidence: In Field_temporal::get_equal_const_item_datetime, Datetime options for TIMESTAMP fields now use Timestamp::DatetimeOptions instead of Options_cmp, so an invalid '2010-00-01' is not turned into a literal later fed to sec_since_epoch.

rationale: A constant with a zero month was substituted into the condition and then converted to a timestamp, hitting the assert in sec_since_epoch. The fix stops the bad substitution at its source in field.cc.
